summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography of László Sáry, a Hungarian composer and pianist born in Győrasszonyfa, Hungary, on 1 January 1940. It says he began composing in a minimal style in the 1970s. It also says he gained recognition in 2002 for scores he wrote for numerous animated works, and that the Kecskemét Animation Film Festival Jury gave him a prize for Best Music.
one_line: Hungarian composer and pianist László Sáry, born 1940, known for minimal-style music and scores for animated works.
key_facts: László Sáry is a Hungarian composer.
László Sáry is a Hungarian pianist.
László Sáry was born in Győrasszonyfa, Hungary.
László Sáry was born on 1 January 1940.
László Sáry began composing in a minimal style in the 1970s.
László Sáry received recognition in 2002 for having created the scores for numerous animated works.
László Sáry was awarded a prize by the Kecskemét Animation Film Festival Jury for Best Music.
The Kecskemét Animation Film Festival Jury gave its Best Music prize to László Sáry.
